Zelensky:
I think Trump had a special relationship with Putin, and still does.
Maybe it really is possible that Trump being on friendly terms with Putin could have prevented a full-scale invasion.
But one thing you have to know for sure: neither I nor Trump are eternal in these presidential seats.
Either way, Trump's presidency would have ended, and Putin still wouldn't have changed his main goal — the occupation of Ukraine.
So I think, honestly, it doesn't matter who the president is as long as Putin is there.
